title: FLE affiliates sit-in outside foundation offices in northern Bujumbura
notes: Boundary discovery rather than proven January continuation. January 4 Monday publication says preceding Tuesday: December 29, 2020 by calendar resolution. About 100 affiliates report withheld contributions and mismanagement. No January gathering established; domestic state target unresolved. Cabinet request for ministry oversight does not prove meeting with protest leaders or accommodation at sit-in. Prior arrests/torture grievances not current-event response.

start_date.summary: Preceding Tuesday relative to January 4 publication resolves to December 29.
